 "score_claims": "Official 48-match receipts recorded in experiments/official-runs.md: 4.54 (Lance-derived Python bot, quiet-movement switch on, zone-crossing commitment; receipt BB-407987E8); 4.67 (same bot at normal speed + finish-supply-capture rule; BB-2DE41BE7); 5.08 (TTUN v8-econ derivative with cube-pile ranking; BB-74CEE7A0); 5.10 (TTUN v8-econ derivative with a walkability check on short direct routes, and WITHOUT the cube-pile ranking; BB-EAEAF89A).  "architecture": "Two unrelated codebases, both single-pass rule cascades evaluated every decision (no planner, no learned parts, no explicit state machine beyond a few latches).\n\n(A) Default-branch Python bot (scored 4.54/4.67). One movement mode is chosen per tick by a fixed priority: (1) urgent zone (outside, or within 8 m of the current edge); (2) cover, if retreating, facing many threats, or out-ranged, unless a close fight or a finishing kill is on; (3) must-go zone travel; (4) finish an almost-complete supply capture; (5) cube pickup; (6) weapon loot when holding neither laser nor lightning; (7) fight; (8) weapon loot; (9) roam. Aiming and firing are computed separately from the movement mode, then a projectile/laser dodge vector is blended over the movement. Strategy switches come from an environment variable; only the quiet-movement switch is on in the shipped image (an engagement filter, faster strafing, earlier zone departure and tighter laser tolerance exist but are off). Every map/nav failure degrades to map-less play instead of crashing; a per-tick millisecond clock skips expensive checks when late.\n\n(B) Practice-branch TypeScript bot (scored 5.08/5.10; TTUN v8-econ plus small edits). Keeps a 12 s memory of mechs, 25 s of drones, 40 s of cubes, 60 s of pickups. Target = minimum of distance + 90 x HP fraction + 30 x seconds since seen, minus 50 if it hit us in the last 3 s, minus 40 stickiness; only tracks younger than 4 s qualify. If a target exists the bot is in fight mode (with a retreat sub-mode when 'losing'); otherwise: heal (stand still or creep to cover) > zone goal > best loot objective by a distance-minus-bonus score over weapons, cubes, supply drops, drones, crates > roam on a ring inside the next circle. Mid-fight it will still divert to nearby cubes/weapons.",
 "navigation": "(A) Python: buildings rasterised to a 2 m grid storing top and base per cell, plus terrain heights; trees are ignored entirely. A 4 m walk grid with the mech radius baked in (centre plus four probes 2.5 m out must be free). Path search is an incremental A* (8-connected, octile heuristic, no corner cutting, capped at 25,000 expansions) that is only started when the goal is more than 8 m away and the straight grid line is blocked; it runs in slices until about 26 ms into the tick and resumes next tick. A path is reused while the goal stays within 4 cells; the follower targets the furthest waypoint within 32 m of path length that has a clear grid line, and replans when more than 28 m off the route. Local steering scores 16 headings by alignment with the desired direction plus a small momentum term, penalising headings blocked at 3, 6 or 10 m. No path planning in fight mode or when standing more than 3 m above ground (roof/air). Stuck handling: commanded to move but under 2.5 m/s for ~0.6 s -> if the obstacle ahead is less than 40 m tall and energy > 35, jump and jet for 2.5 s, otherwise take a random roughly sideways detour for 1.5 s. A slower watchdog every 2.5 s forces a replan when less than 5 m of progress was made toward a goal more than 20 m away, and triggers the jump-jet climb on the second strike. Jets are also used to hop onto a roof when within 14 m of a wanted pickup that is more than 1.5 m higher.\n\n(B) TypeScript: 1 m raster, 2 m walk grid needing a ~5 x 5 m clear window and at most 2.2 m height change to neighbours. Instead of A* it computes a Dijkstra distance field from the goal over the whole map, time-sliced: goals are bucketed to 5 m, a pending computation is not restarted for a goal within 25 m, and each tick it spends whatever is left of a 20 ms budget (max 70,000 node pops, wall clock checked every 1,024 pops). Steering reads the last finished field by sampling 24 directions up to 5 cells out. A straight line is used when the goal is under 60 m and a 2 m-high sight line is clear. r1ver's 5.10 edit: when grounded and travelling (zone/roam/loot/heal) the straight line must also be walkable on the nav grid including diagonal corners, else fall back to the field. Stuck: under 0.25 m moved per tick for 0.6 s -> jump + jet; after 2.5 s try the perpendicular; reset at 4 s. Strictly ground-level: pickups, cubes and crates more than 2 m above terrain are ignored.",
 "aiming_and_fire_control": "(A) Python. Gun: two-pass linear lead on the body centre (4.5 m x size scale) with an extra 0.05 s, vertical lead clamped to +/-6 m; fires when yaw error is within atan(1.6 x target radius / distance) + 0.012 rad and pitch within atan(3 m / distance) + 0.004; never beyond gun range minus 3 m. Laser: starts charging as soon as any shootable mech or drone is inside range minus 5 m and the weapon is off cooldown; aims at the position 0.1 s ahead; releases only at full charge and on target; if within 0.25 s of the forced auto-fire and misaligned it lets go anyway; with no target it keeps holding (up to 1.5 s past full) while any enemy is remembered. Lasers are not spent on crates when a gun is held. Lightning: fired when inside range minus 1 m, energy at least cost + 1, and the target within 40% of the cone angle of the current yaw. Reload only when there is no target and the magazine is under 60%. If hit by an attacker it cannot see while the current target is further than 45 m, it stops shooting and turns to the damage bearing (unless a laser charge is in progress). Idle look priority: unseen-attacker bearing > damage bearing (3 s) > nearest remembered enemy > recent non-far sound (2 s) > continuous spin at 0.35 rad per tick.\n\n(B) TypeScript. Gun lead iterated three times and includes the age of the track; direct (no-lead) aim when lightning is in reach or the laser is charging/ready. Gun tolerance atan(2.2 x scale / distance) x 1.2. Laser: charge when the target is currently seen in range and (line of fire clear or closer than 60 m), release when full and aligned within 0.9 x tolerance. Mortar (kept if picked up): ballistic solution, low arc with line of fire, high arc without, 18-220 m, lead time = distance / (0.7 x shell speed), fires only when no other weapon is firing and aim is within 0.03 rad. Reload outside fights under 50% magazine. Drones/crates: simple lead at gun speed, fire gun (and lightning inside 40 m) within atan(1.2/d). Their later behavior-repair branch fixes real fire-control faults: both weapons share one torso so the gun now fires only if both the current aim and the requested aim are inside the gun's window; cooldown and ammo are checked; the laser is no longer released at the scan angle when the target is lost; no reload while the gun is on target.",
 "survival_and_anti_squad_tactics": "Nothing in the repo is designed specifically for the 15-bot hunting squad; no kiting plan, no regen-cycle scheduling, no handling of the single early hunter or the late all-hunt phase. What exists is generic:\n\n(A) Python: cover mode when HP < 38% with a visible threat (latched until HP > 80%, or 12 s undamaged and > 60%), or 3+ visible threats within 240 m, or 2+ with HP < 60%, or incoming damage over the last 2.5 s above 110/s, or being hit by an unseen attacker, or 'out-ranged' (a visible laser carrier beyond 70 m while holding no laser). Cover search samples 16 directions x 7 distances (7-75 m) along walkable rays; score = 100 per threat (nearest three) that can still see the point + 0.8 per metre, a small bonus for moving away from threats, big penalties outside the current/next circle; re-validated every 3 ticks, recomputed at most every 4, kept for up to 40 ticks; boosts for 2 s after taking damage. With no cover: fetch a laser/lightning within 90 m if HP > 30%, else stand and trade; if out-ranged with HP > 50% and one threat, rush to 22 m. Close fights (< 40 m with lightning or HP > 50%) and finishing kills (target <= 30% HP within 130 m, own HP > 30%, at most 2 threats) override cover. Fight spacing 110 m with laser, 28 m with lightning, 85 m gun-only, strafing with sign flips every 1.0-2.6 s. Dodge: sidestep the line of a visible charging laser if within 7 m + 3% of range of it (boost if energy > 30), but if holding lightning and the charger is inside 40 m it attacks instead because lightning shorts the laser; sidestep bullets whose closest approach is within 3.8 m in 0.02-0.45 s; run from mortar shells predicted to land within 13 m in under 3.5 s. Quiet movement: speed capped at 4.6 m/s (under the 5 m/s footstep threshold) in roam/cube/cover when an enemy is remembered or a sound was heard within 8 s, no damage for 3 s and no zone pressure. Unseen attackers are modelled as a pseudo-threat 120 m along the damage bearing so cover logic reacts to them.\n\n(B) TypeScript: 'losing' = HP < 35% and enemy HP fraction at least 0.1 higher, or 2+ recently seen mechs within 160 m and HP < 55%, or 3+ and HP < 80%; then run to the nearest walkable point hidden from the target's eye (rings every 6 m out to 50 m, 16 bearings), boosting if energy > 15, and set a 6 s hide timer. Heal mode when no target, no zone need and no cube within 40 m: HP < 55% (or < 90% while the hide timer runs) -> stand still, or creep at 40% speed into cover from the last seen mech. Fight spacing 28 / 110 / 70 m (lightning / laser / gun) with a +/-15 m band, strafe flips every 0.35-1.05 s, boost-strafe when the target's charging laser points within 0.25 rad of us. Dodge mixes 95% sidestep into movement for bullets passing within 3.6 m x scale in under 0.9 s and shells landing within 11 m in under 3 s.",
 "loot_weapons_upgrades": "(A) Python: wants only laser and lightning and never a mortar (laser cook-off risk). The gun is the first thing dropped, then a mortar, so the end loadout is laser + lightning with no gun. Wanted pickups are sought out to 240 m while holding neither (160 m after), within 25 m vertically, and must lie in the safe circle unless closer than 30 m. Gun-only bots loot before fighting when the target is beyond 50 m or the pickup is within 20 m. Cubes: within 70 m, same level (+/-4 m), HP > 35%, at most one real threat. Roam order: cubes within 120 m > supply drop within 170 m that lands by arrival + 8 s when calm and HP > 45% (skipped if another mech already has > 1.5 s of capture) > shoot visible crates (<= 150 m, close to 22 m) and drones (<= 140 m, HP > 55%, hold at 50 m) > remembered crates within 260 m when HP > 60% > drift to within 55% of the next radius. r1ver's own addition: if it is the capture holder with at most 1 s left and no threats, stay in the ring. Upgrade order: plating, armor, nanites, laser damage, lightning efficiency, gun rate, laser charge, gun damage, capacitor, reactor, gyros, lightning range, ... mortar upgrades last.\n\n(B) TypeScript: weapon values laser 3.2 > lightning 2.5 > mortar 1 > gun 0; the gun is never dropped; the worse non-gun weapon is replaced only by something worth 0.5 more (so mortar is kept until a lightning/laser turns up, lightning is replaced by laser). Loot score (lower wins): weapon distance - 20 x value - 50 if a slot is empty; cube distance - 30; supply drop distance - 80 (within 220 m, lands by arrival + 3 s, not held by someone else, not outside the next circle with under 15 s to shrink; stand still once inside radius - 3 m); drone distance - 20 (within 170 m, HP > 50%, stop at 38 m); crate distance + 5 (within 150 m, HP > 45%, stop at 30 m). Mid-fight diversions: cube within 70 m (40 m at HP <= 50%, 12 m when losing), weapon within 60 m gun-only / 35 m otherwise. Upgrade order: plating, armor, nanites, lightning efficiency, laser damage, laser charge, gun damage, gun rate, lightning range, lightning chain, gyros, servos, gun mag, capacitor, reactor, jets, ... Cube-pile variant (the 5.08 build): cubes currently seen together within one pickup radius are counted (up to 4); trip cost = distance - 14 per extra cube that still raises stats (cap at 10) - 12 if the pile crosses the next upgrade threshold that a single cube would not.",
 "zone_and_endgame": "(A) Python: safety margin = min(30 m, 30% of next radius). 'Must go' when walking time for the shortfall plus 12 s exceeds the time left until shrink start (or until shrink end once shrinking); 'urgent' when outside or within 8 m of the current edge. r1ver's fix: the base bot switched its deadline from shrink start to shrink end at the moment shrinking began, which could cancel a crossing halfway; they latch the commitment to the triggering circle until the mech is inside its inner margin (latch clears when the next circle changes). Zone goal is the next centre; boost when urgent with energy > 25, or when more than 60 m short with energy > 60; any non-zone goal outside the next circle is replaced by the centre under must-go; cover points outside the circles are heavily penalised; dodge strength is halved when urgent. No endgame-specific logic.\n\n(B) TypeScript: zone goal is the point at 45% of the next radius on the bearing from the next centre toward the mech; triggered when out of zone, beyond 90% of the current radius, or outside 80% of the next radius while shrinking or with less than (travel time to 60% radius + 12 s) left. Boost only when actually outside. During a fight the zone goal takes over movement only once the mech is outside the zone. Idle roam sits on a ring at up to 60% of the next radius. No final-circle or last-few-alive special cases. Experimental branches (unscored): prioritise the crossing when remaining shrink time is within 2 s of walking time; replace an unreachable zone waypoint by the nearest connected floor cell inside the next circle; add 0.65 x extra detour distance to loot cost when outside the inner 55% of the next circle and shrink is within 45 s.",
 "housebot_observations": "No direct forensics of the scorer's house bots (no replay analysis, no statement about squad targeting or shared vision). Indirect evidence only: (1) Quiet movement did not pay on the real scorer: the same upstream bot scored 4.54 creeping vs 4.67 at normal speed for r1ver (confounded with a capture fix) and 4.54 vs 4.75 in another team's (BackwardsDeployeds) official log, consistent with house bots not depending on hearing us. (2) Real outcomes look all-or-nothing: in their local squad model 51 of 80 baseline matches scored 0-2, 17 scored 15 and only 12 landed in between; they treat official results the same way (integer place-points, 245 vs 263). (3) To make their stand-in squad reproduce the starter bot's real 1.15 they had to multiply house aim noise by 5 and give lasers to only the 3 strongest bots (kit example then scores about 1.2 locally); their stand-in tiers chase within 150 / 260 / 420 / unlimited metres and open fire within 110 / 140 / 170 / 200 m, strafing inside 90 m. These are modelling guesses, not observations. (4) They state explicitly that the official run uses hidden opponents and scenarios, that their practice model omits crates, drones, sounds, beams, contested drops and upgrade offers, and that it agreed with the official ordering in only 3 of 6 pairwise comparisons.",

 "novel_ideas": [
  "Evaluation discipline worth copying: paired seeds for candidate vs baseline, report improved/equal/worse counts and how often the new behaviour actually triggered, keep a held-out seed set, and re-test under a fixed logical clock before believing a delta.",
  "Calibrate the local simulator against several builds with known official scores and count pairwise order agreement before trusting it (theirs managed 3 of 6).",
  "Zone-crossing commitment latch: once a crossing toward the next circle is triggered, stay committed until inside its inner margin, so the deadline switch at shrink start cannot cancel the move midway.",
  "Value cube piles by what they unlock: bonus per extra stat-giving cube collectible from one spot and an extra bonus when the pile crosses the next upgrade threshold (1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21).",
  "Capture guard: if we are the holder of a landed supply drop with under about 1 s left and nothing threatens, do not walk off for a cube or roam goal.",
  "Verify that a 'direct' shortcut is actually walkable on the nav grid (including diagonal corner squeezes) before skipping the path planner; a clear sight line at knee height is not a walkable line.",
  "Unseen attacker handling: turn a damage event from an invisible shooter into a pseudo-threat placed about 120 m along the damage bearing so cover selection and look direction react immediately; stop shooting a distant target to face the hidden one.",
  "Lightning beats a charging laser at close range: inside about 40 m attack with lightning (it shorts lasers for 2 s) instead of dodging the beam.",
  "Sound discipline: cap speed just below the footstep-sound threshold when enemies are remembered nearby and nothing is urgent (their data suggests no benefit against the house squad, possibly useful in the finals against team bots).",
  "Shared-torso fire control: when two weapons need different aim solutions, only fire the gun if both the present aim and the requested aim are inside the gun's hit window; never release a held laser charge at a scan angle after losing the target.",
  "Bullet dodge evaluated in the mech's own moving frame when the planned movement keeps the current velocity, so a bullet that will already miss a moving mech does not trigger a dodge.",
  "Idle 'scan-walk': instead of standing at the roam waypoint, step along the ring around the next centre at silent speed while sweeping the view, and step out of conservatively blocked grid cells using a finer terrain test."
 ],
